name: Animal Hardship Annotation
description: A direct 16:9 animal explainer cover pairing one expressive animal with one restrained hand-drawn hardship note.
composition_guidance: Create a clear 16:9 animal hardship cover with one anatomically legible, expressive animal in its natural setting. Use one hand-drawn arrow that points to one concrete survival constraint and exactly one 3–6 word handwritten hardship annotation. Reserve a readable, uncluttered card for the full episode title rendered directly by the selected image model. Keep the subject, arrow, annotation, and title card in one immediate reading path.
composition_rules: Show one anatomically coherent expressive animal as the undisputed hero.
Use exactly one hand-drawn arrow and exactly one 3–6 word handwritten hardship annotation.
Give the full episode title one readable title card with enough contrast for small-screen viewing.
Keep the title card separate from the animal's face, body, and survival detail.
required_elements: A readable full episode-title card rendered by the image model
avoid_elements: Copied wording from an existing channel's titles or episodes
Multiple arrows or multiple handwritten captions
Generic curiosity-only wording that does not name a concrete constraint
Watermarks, logos, channel branding, or copied trade dress
Violent cruelty, malformed anatomy, or malformed text
headline_guidance: Render the complete intended full episode title directly into the title card. Use one line only when the title remains clearly readable; otherwise split it across two or three balanced lines. Do not reuse any saved episode wording, channel prefix, logo, or fixed catchphrase.
visual_style_guidance: Keep the recipe independent of its active visual style: it requires one legible animal, one arrow, one short hardship note, and a full-title card, while medium, palette, and line treatment come from the selected style.
